::: {.callout-tip title="Entering answers"}
Type answers in the empty fields, then select **Check**. Use `*` for
multiplication, `^` for powers, and parentheses to make grouping clear. Common
forms include `sqrt(2)`, `sin(x)`, `exp(x)`, and `pi`. Enter an exact value
unless the question asks for a decimal approximation. Algebraically equivalent
expressions are normally accepted; when a particular form is required, the
question says so. **Input help** shows the full notation reference.
:::
